description: Takes your approval rules (cost centre or *, amount from, amount to, approver, role, deputy, absent yes/no) and optionally one case (cost centre, amount, requester, person it currently sits with). Returns who must approve the case (the most specific rule whose range covers the amount) and why it is stuck: no rule for the cost centre or the amount above the highest level (red), the requester would approve their own order (red), the approver is away without a deputy (red) or with one (yellow), the case sits with the wrong person (red), two rules with different approvers (yellow). Also lists gaps between amount levels and rules without a deputy. To review a whole approval matrix against a people list use check_approval_matrix. Licence, or one free check every 30 days.

amount_eur.description: Optional: the amount of the case in euros.

cost_center.description: Optional: the cost centre of the case.

current_approver.description: Optional: the person the case currently sits with.

language.description: Language of the answer. Default de.

requester.description: Optional: who requested it, to catch self-approval.

rows.description: One row per rule: cost_center (* for all), from_eur, to_eur (empty for no upper limit), approver, role, deputy, absent. German column names work too (kostenstelle, von, bis, freigebender, rolle, vertretung, abwesend).

name: diagnose_approval
title: Approval diagnosis: who must approve this amount on this cost centre, and why an approval is stuck
